ios.desc:
Your audience, in the room.

Feedr turns any recording or live session into a two-way conversation. Share a 6-character code and your audience joins instantly — no app download, no account, just open a browser.

REAL-TIME COMMENT FEED
Comments from your audience appear on your iPhone in real time. See who's engaging, pin the best question to the top, and react to keep the energy alive — all without breaking your flow.

NO FRICTION FOR YOUR AUDIENCE
Your viewers just tap a link or scan a QR code. Type their name, start commenting. That's it. No app install. No account. Works on any phone, tablet, or computer.

MODERATION BUILT IN
Choose to approve comments before they appear (Creator plan). Block anything that doesn't fit your session with one tap.

REACTIONS
React to comments live — reaction counts are visible to your audience in real time, creating a shared moment without interrupting you.

LIVE POLLS & WORD CLOUDS
Launch a live poll mid-session and watch results roll in instantly. Kick off a word cloud and see your audience's ideas fill the screen. Both tools work on any device — no app required.

SESSION REPORTS
When your session ends, get a full report: top questions, poll results and audience metrics — ready to share or export.

WORKS STANDALONE OR WITH PROMPTR
Use Feedr on its own for any live session, presentation or Q&A. Or combine it with Promptr by MRVL (Pro plan) to run your teleprompter and comment overlay simultaneously.

PLANS
Free — 1 session/month · 20 audience members · upvoting · presenter mode
Creator — Unlimited sessions · 500 audience · moderation · reactions · polls & word clouds · pinned comments · session history
Pro — Unlimited sessions & audience · all Creator features · session analytics · AI-powered insights · Promptr overlay (coming soon)

NOW IN 8 LANGUAGES
Feedr is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings.
